problems.title: 3 Common Digital Roadblocks for Small Businesses
problems.subtitle: Over 90% of local traders and shop owners lose customers because of these 3 hurdles:

item1.title: 1. Customers Can't Find Your Shop on Google
item1.desc: New locals or passing travelers search Google Maps for 'nearest shop/clinic'. Without an active listing, they head straight to your competitors.
item1.impact: Losing 15 to 30 potential customers every month.

item2.title: 2. Billing, Accounts, and Ledgers are Still on Paper
item2.desc: Manual notebooks cause calculation errors, lost pages, and customers don't get printed receipts. Reconciling daily registers wastes 1-2 hours every evening.
item2.impact: Stuck credit (udhari) and massive time waste.

item3.title: 3. Big IT Agencies Quote ₹50,000+ with Complex Jargon
item3.desc: City agencies have large office overheads and project managers. They quote exorbitant rates and communicate in technical terms that don't solve your practical problem.
item3.impact: Budget blowouts with no tangible local results.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, straightforward answers to common questions:

items.q: Will this website or app work smoothly on my budget ₹5,000 to ₹7,000 Android phone?
items.a: Yes, 100%! All sites and applications I build are specifically optimized for budget Android smartphones and load in under 2 seconds even on slow 2G/3G/4G rural networks.

items.q: I don't know computers or English. Can I manage this easily?
items.a: Absolutely! You don't need any technical skills. Everything is built with clear buttons and can be operated in Marathi or English. After launch, I provide a personal 1-on-1 walkthrough over phone or video call.

items.q: What are domain and hosting, and what do they cost every year?
items.a: A domain is your shop's online name (like yourshop.in), and hosting is the secure cloud server where your files live. A .in domain costs approx. ₹600-800/year, and hosting is approx. ₹1,200 to ₹1,800/year. Free cloud tier options are also available.

items.q: What do I need to provide to start, and what are the payment terms?
items.a: Just send your shop name, address, phone number, and a few photos of your store/products via WhatsApp. 50% advance to begin work, and the remaining 50% via PhonePe/GPay only after the project is complete and approved by you.

items.q: If something stops working later, who helps me fix it?
items.a: Viraj Patil directly! You will never have to deal with automated bots or waiting on customer care. Just call or message my personal WhatsApp number.
